cases.title: Normal Drag Product Item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a valid product item (li element with draggable='true') initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Edge Drag Product Item with Special Characters
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item containing special characters in its title or price successfully initiates the drag event and correctly captures the data.

cases.title: Boundary Drag First and Last List Items
cases.description: Verify that dragging the absolute first and last product items in the product list correctly initiates drag events and captures their respective titles and prices.

cases.title: Error Drag Item Without Draggable Attribute
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag an element that lacks the draggable='true' attribute does not initiate a valid product drag transfer event.

cases.title: Drop single unique product into drop area
cases.description: Verify that dropping a valid product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully adds it to the cart, updating .box1 with the quantity, .box2 with the product title, and .box3 with the unit price.

cases.title: Drop repeated products to increment quantity
cases.description: Verify that dropping the same product item multiple times into the drop area updates the cart display correctly, incrementing the quantity in .box1 while maintaining the title in .box2 and unit price in .box3.

cases.title: Drop maximum supported items into drop area
cases.description: Verify that dropping the maximum allowed distinct or total product items into the drop area correctly updates the cart display for all items without failing or missing data updates.

cases.title: Attempt to drop non-product element into drop area
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drop a non-product element that lacks proper product data into the designated drop area is rejected or ignored by the system, leaving the cart display unchanged.

cases.title: Calculate total price for multiple distinct items (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of multiple distinct products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displays it in <div id="allMoney">.

cases.title: Calculate total price with zero items or single item (Edge)
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates and displays '$0.00' when the cart is empty, and correctly formats a single item's price with two decimal places and the currency symbol.

cases.title: Handle large price values (Boundary)
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates and formats very large price sums without rounding errors or layout overflow in <div id="allMoney">.

cases.title: Handle malformed price strings in cart items (Error/Abnormal)
cases.description: Verify that the system gracefully handles or sanitizes malformed price strings in the cart without causing uncaught runtime exceptions during total price calculation.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are covered with appropriate normal, edge, boundary, and error scenarios. No blockers found.
All requirements and their corresponding test cases have been reviewed. The cases cover normal, edge, boundary, and error scenarios comprehensively, and no blockers were found.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1, testable behavior includes initiating a drag event on 'li' elements with draggable='true' and capturing product title and price. Scenarios: Normal (dragging a valid product item), Edge (dragging an item with special characters in title/price), Boundary (dragging the first or last item in the list), Abnormal/Error (attempting to drag an item without draggable attribute). For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3, testable behavior includes dropping product items into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') and updating .box1 (quantity), .box2 (title), and .box3 (unit price). Scenarios: Normal (dropping a single unique product), Edge (dropping repeated products to test quantity increments), Boundary (dropping the maximum supported items), Abnormal/Error (dropping a non-product element into the drop area). For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5, testable behavior includes calculating the total price of all cart items and displaying it formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol in <div id='allMoney'>. Scenarios: Normal (calculating total for multiple distinct items), Edge (calculating total with zero items or single item), Boundary (handling large price values), Abnormal/Error (handling malformed price strings in cart items).
